proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(fontawesome))
invisible(fa("r-project", fill = "red", title = "R"))
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  result <- as.character(fa("r-project", fill = "red", title = "R"))
  elapsed[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
}
cat(sprintf("r_ms %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
cat(result, "\n")
proof.python:
import statistics
import time
from fontawesome.fa import fa

fa("r-project", fill="red", title="R")
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    result = fa("r-project", fill="red", title="R")
    elapsed.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
print(f"py_ms {statistics.median(elapsed) * 1000:.17g}")
print(result)
